title: Astrometry agent does not free its device private data at shutdown
summary: INDIGO_DRIVER_INIT allocates astrometry_private_data for the agent device (indigo_drivers/agent_astrometry/indigo_agent_astrometry.c:1340); INDIGO_DRIVER_SHUTDOWN detaches and frees the device but not device->private_data (528 bytes per load/unload). Next: free the private data after detach.
evidence: indigo_drivers/agent_astrometry/indigo_agent_astrometry.c:1340 and the INDIGO_DRIVER_SHUTDOWN case; valgrind, task verification.md

resolution.evidence: Task 20261025152706-abbf-fix-server-leaks verification.md V1: the leak check reports 0 bytes definitely lost after the fix.
